data: What is the F1 score of the blue line when the number of RC instances is approximately 40000?

The blue line represents the performance of the NewsQA model. The x-axis shows the number of RC instances, and the y-axis shows the F1 score. The question asks for the F1 score of the blue line when the number of RC instances is approximately 40000. From the graph, we can see that at around 40000 RC instances, the F1 score of the blue line is approximately 32.
